transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because since my daughter left for basic training, I just haven’t been right. I come home and the house feels dead, and I can’t seem to keep myself together. I’m crying in my truck before shifts, messing up steps on welding jobs I’ve done for years, snapping at the younger guys at work. And I’ve stopped doing things I used to care about, like going out on the water or working on my sculpture. I just… don’t see the point lately.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About a month. It started right after my daughter left for basic training, and I’ve been struggling like this since then.
Have you ever experienced these kinds of feelings before, or is this the first time you’ve felt this way?
I mean, I’ve had rough patches before like anybody, but not like this. I was managing okay before my daughter shipped out. This really started within a few weeks of her leaving for basic training.
Have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, like going out on the water or working on your sculpture?

Yeah. I have. I used to look forward to getting out on the water, or spending time on my sculpture, but lately I just… don’t see the point. Since my daughter left, the house feels empty, and I can’t seem to get myself together enough to care about those things.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately?
I haven’t really noticed any big change. I mean, my eating’s probably been a little off here and there, but I’m not sure about weight or anything.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep lately, like trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or waking up too early?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been keeping track of it. Some nights feel harder than others, but I can’t say exactly if I’m falling asleep late or waking up early or anything like that.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, have you been more restless or fidgety lately?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed if I’m moving slower or talking slower. I don’t think I’ve been especially fidgety either, at least not that I can tell.
Have you found yourself feeling worthless or guilty about things more than usual lately?
I don’t really know. I wouldn’t say I’ve been feeling worthless exactly. Maybe I’ve been second-guessing myself more, but I’m not sure about guilt more than usual.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, have you been more restless or fidgety lately?
Like I said, I really haven’t noticed anything clear with that. I don’t think I’m moving or talking slower, and I don’t feel especially restless. Nothing that stands out to me.
Have you had any thoughts about death or dying lately, or found yourself wishing you were dead?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t had anything specific like that come up that I can point to.
Have you had days where you felt like nothing really interested you, or that you couldn’t enjoy anything, not even things you usually like?

Yeah. Since my daughter left for basic training, it’s like the house is just dead when I come home. I don’t really want to do anything. I used to like going out on the water, and I’d work on my sculpture, but lately I just don’t see the point. I’m barely keeping it together.
Have you noticed that you’re feeling more tired or that you have less energy lately, even when you’re not doing much physically?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I feel worn down, but I haven’t noticed it as a clear “I have no energy” thing. It’s hard to separate, honestly.
Have you had days where you felt down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, since your daughter left for basic training?

Yeah. Pretty much since she left, most days feel heavy. I come home and the house feels dead, and I just kind of fall apart. I’m crying in my truck before work sometimes, and even at work I’m messing up steps on welding jobs I’ve done for years. I snap at the younger guys, and I don’t even go out on the water or work on my sculpture anymore. I just don’t see the point lately.
Have you noticed any trouble concentrating or thinking clearly lately, especially when doing things that used to feel routine?

Yeah, I have. At work especially. I’m missing steps on welding jobs I’ve done for years, stuff I shouldn’t even have to think about. My head just isn’t there. I’ll be trying to focus and then I just... drift, or get overwhelmed, and then I mess something up. It’s been bad since my daughter left.
Have you had days where you felt down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, since your daughter left for basic training?

Yeah. I know I already said some of it, but yes—since she left, most days I’ve been down. I come home and the house just feels dead, and I can’t really keep myself together. I’ll cry in my truck before a shift, then go into work and miss steps on welding jobs I’ve done for years. I’ve been snapping at the younger guys too. And I don’t even go out on the water or work on my sculpture anymore, because… I just don’t see the point right now.
Before this current period, have you ever had an episode of depression that lasted for several weeks and then completely went away, where you felt back to your usual self again?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had rough patches like anybody, but I can’t remember anything like several weeks of depression and then just going back to normal. This feels different.
Have you ever had a period in your life when you felt down or lost interest in things for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks in a row—before this current time?
I don’t think so. Not like that, no. I’ve had bad days or stress before, but I can’t remember any time before now where it was most of the day, every day, for two weeks or more.

Before this current time, have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks where you felt down or lost interest in things most of the day, nearly every day, along with other symptoms like changes in sleep, appetite, energy, or trouble concentrating?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of a time before this where it went on like that for two weeks or more. I’ve had stress and bad stretches, but nothing that stands out to me the way this does.

Before this current time, have you ever had a period where you felt down or lost interest in things most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks, even if it didn’t last as long as this one?
No, I really don’t think I have. I’ve been upset or stressed before, but not like being down most of the day, nearly every day for two weeks. Nothing before this comes to mind.
